title: CoursePulse courses
description: Shape of data/courses.json: a list of courses. Module lists and durations are written by hand for this site; the access note records what the course page said about cost when it was last read.

duration_hours.description: Rough estimate written for this site unless the access note quotes the provider's own figure.

modules.description: A study checklist written for this site. It is not copied from the course and may not match the course's own structure.

kind.description: free: a quoted sentence on the provider's page says it is free. free_paid_certificate: free to learn, and the page says the certificate costs money. no_cost_stated: public page that does not mention cost. class_site: a university's website for its own enrolled students. terms_unclear: the page does not say what is free. not_checked: the page could not be read.

checked_by.description: A person's name, or agent:<model> when an AI agent read the page.
